clarifications.statement: cairo 1.18.4 is offered under either the GNU LGPL 2.1 or the Mozilla Public License 1.1, as its retained COPYING states, and both real texts are bound; the upstream licence table's 'Mozilla Public License 2.0' label is not the retained text and is not relied on here.

obligations.detail: The operative LGPL-3.0 and GPL-3.0 texts and the libvips LGPL-2.1 origin text are digest-bound into the generated notices; no relicensing is implied.
The upstream README licence table and the exact versions.json component versions are digest-bound into the generated notices.

All 29 libraries named by the tarball README (28 versioned components plus libnsgif vendored inside libvips) have exact source-archive copyright/licence files bound in componentNotices; unchanged components retain verified historical paths. Rust crates linked through librsvg are covered by Config/SharpLibvipsRustProvenance.json (161 crates.io crates, 159 observed compiling in the retained build log, with the licence texts their archives carry); incorporation into the shipped dylib is not verified.

Config/SharpLibvipsSourceMaterials.json pins the 28 upstream source archives, 4 patches and build recipe of the exact 1.3.3 build commit, and Config/SharpLibvipsRustProvenance.json pins 161 crates.io crates for librsvg-c (159 observed compiling in the retained build log), all by URL, size and SHA-256. The acquisition tool retains these inputs privately. None is shipped or offered with the binary, incorporation into the dylib is unverified and no rebuild was attempted: no corresponding-source offer exists yet.

libvips-cpp.8.18.6.dylib is dynamically loaded, but the app is intended to ship Developer ID signed with hardened runtime; whether a user can replace the library and re-run the app, and whether LGPL-3.0 section 4(d)/4(e) and GPL-3.0 section 6 Installation Information requirements apply, has not been assessed. Entitlements and signing policy are outside this record.
No formal legal clearance is claimed for redistributing this binary. The public external evidence gate thirdPartyBinaryLicenseMaterials remains the human review point.
